name: Web
author: Erin Carter
description: A single orb-weaver's web hung across the dark from an off-centre hub: a dozen-odd irregular radial spokes crossed by a slightly wonky Archimedean spiral. Hairline silk barely glows while dew beads at the crossings glint awake in slow travelling sequence around the web, their colour wandering through a restrained rainbow, the whole structure trembling a few pixels in the night air.

params.label: Spokes
params.effect: Number of radial silk spokes, and therefore dew beads per ring; low is a sparse broken-looking web, high a fine dense wheel.

params.label: Ring spacing
params.effect: Radial gap between spiral passes in CSS px; tight spacing gives many close rings crowded with dew, wide gives a few sweeping rings.

params.label: Tremble
params.effect: Amplitude of the night-air shiver displacing the whole web; 0 hangs it dead still, max makes the silk visibly quiver.

params.label: Glint speed
params.effect: Rate at which dew beads light up in sequence around the web, from one slow circuit per half-minute to a lively sparkle chase.

params.label: Webs
params.effect: How many webs hang at receding depths; 1 is a single near web, 3 stacks two fainter webs behind it for depth.

params.label: Depth fade
params.effect: Brightness of the farthest web relative to the near one; low sinks the back webs into the dark, high brings them forward.

params.label: Depth of field
params.effect: How much the far webs are softened out of focus; 0 keeps every web crisp, high blurs the back silk and dew into a haze.

params.label: Irregularity
params.effect: Spoke-angle and spiral-radius wonkiness; 0 is a perfect mechanical wheel, 1 a real orb-weaver's slightly crooked web, high a tangled mess.

params.label: Depth hue
params.effect: How far the far webs' dew colour rotates away from the near web's, separating the depth planes by hue.
